name: 07644 · Lodi, NJ
findings: ZIP 07644 (Lodi) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07644 (Lodi) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07644 (Lodi) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
